post.content:
Really excited about this event next week; 
This upcoming event is focused on the beauty industry - a sector that continues to show incredible growth, innovation and resilience. 
Whilst our women in business events haven’t been industry specific before, I’m looking forward to bringing together professionals from this space to share insights, opportunities and perspectives on what’s driving success. 
The beauty sector is evolving rapidly and it’s an exciting time to support businesses navigating that growth. 

Looking forward to welcoming everyone. Check out the comments to sign up.
